name: Tsuyuri Touka
source:
She used to be a regular girl going to school in the city, but one day she manifested a Special Power that turned her invisible. As a result, she was forced to live as a person, invisible to anyone.

The girl has witnessed the perpetrator of the underground electricity cable bombing case. Due to it, she came to cooperate with the protagonist and his division.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.propeller-game.com/product/yuzuriha/chara20.html]official site[/url]]
